title: Stop at the end of the list
instructions: A list of 3 has boxes 0, 1 and 2. There is no box 3!
i <= scores.size() lets i reach 3, so the loop asks for a box that isn't there. The program crashes.
i < scores.size() stops at 2, the last real box.
task: This program crashes. Fix the loop so it prints:  Total: 15
hint:
Stop before the size, not at it:

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < scores.size(); i = i + 1) {
